##   Corrupt your world. Break reality. Rewrite Minecraft.

  Have you ever wondered what it would feel like to completely ruin your Minecraft experience… in the most chaotic way possible?

  Well—this is it.

The mod doesn't just change textures… it corrupts them. Every block, every item, every detail is twisted into something unrecognizable—glitched, distorted, and beautifully broken. It’s the Minecraft you know… turned into something you don’t.

  And it gets worse (or better).

  The corruption shifts with your MipMap level. Increase it, and reality tears even further apart. Lower it, and the chaos mutates into something different. No two experiences feel exactly the same.
  This also applies on how the texture filtering is set, and, if on, how the anisotropic filtering level is set.

  Once applied, your world becomes a nightmare of unreadable textures, visual glitches, and pure hellish chaos. Nothing looks right. Nothing feels safe.

  But that’s the point.

  So stop reading.
Download it.
And watch your Minecraft fall apart.

“Perfection is boring… but corruption reveals the truth beneath reality.”

Go ahead—
break your game.
-0nullvoid0
